rationale: The stock has gapped down ~6% on a securities fraud class action lawsuit, creating a highly uncertain environment with elevated volatility (ATR ~$1.83 on 5m bars) and erratic 1-minute price action — the last candle dropped sharply from ~$158 to $156.54 on nearly 5x relative volume, suggesting continued selling pressure but no clean directional setup.
